title: Exterior weight and the improved Friedgut family
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be natural numbers, let $f$ be a sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $\epsilon,\eta\in\mathbb{R}$. The sum of the squared Fourier coefficients of its real-valued version over sets outside the improved Friedgut family equals the sum over coordinate sets $S$ with $|S|\le k$ that are not contained in the coordinates whose Boolean influence is at least the improved Friedgut threshold.
hypotheses_covered: sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
